$schema-note: Each entry names one file and one literal substring that must still be in it. Adding an entry is how a fix with no test of its own keeps a guard. See tests/witness.test.mjs for what this does and does not prove.

fixes.why: The gate is opt-in. Its test file exercises the pure decision function and never this line, so relaxing the comparison to `!== '0'` would turn a Stop hook on for every user with the whole suite green. CLAUDE.md forbids anything new being on by default.

A task id's prefix is a heuristic; bd ids are short, so `acme-storefront` with tasks reading `acme-6f` resolved to `acme`, and the board told the operator in red that a healthy setup was broken. The E2E test covers this but SKIPs when Playwright is absent, and a skip is not a check.

Every README screenshot carried a red error banner for releases because nothing looked at the page before photographing it. Deleting this selector restores that silently — the shots still generate, they are just wrong, and nobody re-reads their own README.

This interpolated task titles and bd-supplied ids into `cd $ROOT && bd ...` behind hand-rolled escaping that covered double quotes and nothing else. The file has no test of its own, so a return to string commands would be caught by nothing.

Paths reached ffmpeg through a shell here. Like seed-demo this file has no test, and a demo recorder is exactly the kind of script whose regression nobody notices until a path contains a space or a quote.

The previous line ended `: 'PASS'`, which turned an empty body, a refusal and a wrong-format reply into a passing review that the Stop hook then ended the turn on. Restoring the PASS branch is a one-word edit whose damage is silent and downstream.

The gate used to treat anything that was not BLOCK as a pass, which is why the laundering one floor below reached it unnoticed. Widening this back to `=== 'BLOCK'` re-opens the same path and no other test would fail.

Without this the hook reads a backgrounded agent's launch as its completion and tells the reader to record a verdict for work that has not happened. Widening it to a bare `return true` silences the no-verdict check entirely, and only the fail-closed test notices.
